items.summary: Remove all Internet Identity and Google authentication dependencies from the frontend, including the useInternetIdentity hook, AuthClient usage, and Internet Identity provider wrapper
Implement a traditional username/password login form on the LoginPage component replacing the 'Sign in with Google' button, with fields for username/ID and password, maintaining the dark mode styling
Create backend Motoko functions to securely store user credentials with password hashing, supporting user creation with username, hashed password, role (admin/staff/student), and name fields
Implement backend authentication function that verifies username and password credentials, returns a session token or user identity on success, and supports role-based access control
Create an admin-only account creation interface accessible from the Layout navigation menu, with form fields for username/ID, password, role selection (Admin/Teacher/Staff/Student), and name
Update the useAuth hook to manage username/password authentication state instead of Internet Identity, including login, logout, and session persistence functionality
Update the useActor hook to initialize the backend actor with session-based authentication instead of Internet Identity principal
Remove the ProfileSetupModal component since user profiles will be created by admins during account creation with all necessary information
Update backend migration.mo to preserve existing user profile data during the transition from Internet Identity to username/password authentication system
